segments.he: [סִימָן: (אָמַר לֵיהּ) לֹא נַעֲשֶׂה מַעֲשֶׂיהָ בְּמִיתָה נַעֲשֶׂה וְלֹא נַעֲשֶׂה בְּוָלָד יִבֻּם וּתְרוּמָה יִבּוּם וּתְרוּמָה — סִימָן].
segments.en: Parenthetically, the Gemara lists terms signifying the following discussions, to serve as «a mnemonic» device: «Said to him, we should not make, by death, we should make and not make, by a child, yavam and teruma, levirate marriage and teruma.» This list of terms, taken from the introductions or key phrases in each of the ensuing discussions, is the «mnemonic.»

moves.summary: lists key words of the coming discussions as a memory aid

unresolved.issue: a mnemonic has no party-to-party interaction; transmit.supplies_mnemonic_for was already rejected by the registry, so no edge is emitted
